movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms out in Creepin; pointing hand gesture to challenge an opponent.
movement_profile.footwork: Fluid leg-oriented style including footwalks like Crazy legs and Walk-out.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Side-to-side movement in The Slot or Fresno.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Utilizing rolls of the hips, knees, legs, and head; twisting various parts in sequence like a Rubik's Cube in Twist-o-flex.

signature_moves.description: A foundational step of Boogaloo done in Oakland inspired by cartoon's Goofy, typically done as an entry and exit step with arms out, legs extended.
signature_moves.name: Creepin

signature_moves.description: A footwalk created by Poppin Pete by watching a boy called Crazy Legs.
signature_moves.name: Crazy legs

signature_moves.description: A side-to-side movement ending in a hard pose or hit with the leg and arm of the side moved to.
signature_moves.name: Fresno / The Slot

signature_moves.description: A technique creating the impression of unnatural body joints by moving and twisting parts in sequence.
signature_moves.name: Twist-o-flex

music_profile.sound_description: Danced to funk music, with specific tempo and instrumentation not detailed in the sources.
